notes: Clean course dominated by false positives: most collisions are a single agglutinative Sinhala token (pronouns ඒ/මම/ඔයා, negator නෑ, intensifier ගොඩක්, modal ඕනේ) glossed many ways as 'component' slices inside larger LEGOs, plus routine English morphology (word/words, speak/speaks, going/is going). The high-frequency tokens are all FP, so there are zero release-blockers. The real fixes are nearly all low-severity BUILD-fragment-vs-USE-sentence near-duplicates and it/that demonstrative wobble that should be consolidated; only two genuine meaning splits (counterfactual vs past කිව්වේ නෑ, progressive vs habitual කතා කරනවා) and two garbled/mis-glossed data rows.
